basics.name: Haoran Lai
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate in Biomedical Engineering at USTC. Research on 3D medical vision-language models, cross-modal alignment, and reinforcement learning for clinical reasoning.

work.company: iFLYTEK Co., Ltd. — Smart Healthcare Institute
work.summary: Participated in multimodal medical AI research and development.
highlights: XiaoYi Medical QA System: Developed medical dialogue generation module; introduced knowledge graphs and RAG techniques to improve professional accuracy.
iFLYTEK Spark Medical LLM: Led image-text alignment algorithm research; proposed cross-modal alignment optimization module for dynamic fusion of medical image and report features.
